bind_address.description: Network interface IP or hostname gfmd binds to for client connections. Use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces.

port.description: TCP port gfmd listens on for client connections (standard: 1500).

metadata_dir.description: Absolute path to the directory storing GFarm metadata database files.

num_worker_threads.description: Number of worker threads to handle client requests. Increase under high concurrency.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level: debug, info, warning, error.

log_file.description: Path to the gfmd log file.

enable_md_replication.description: Enable MD (metadata) replication with peer gfmd instances for HA.

md_replication_peers.description: List of hostnames/IPs of peer gfmd daemons for replication.

items.description: Hostname or IP of a peer gfmd server.

replication_port.description: Port used for inter-daemon metadata replication traffic.

replication_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for replication operations before failing.

replication_max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous replication connections allowed.

auth_method.description: Authentication method for client connections: gssapi, password, sslcert, or none.

keytab_file.description: Path to the Kerberos keytab file (required if auth_method = gssapi).

krb_service_name.description: Kerberos service principal name (e.g., gfmd or gfmd/hostname).

ssl_cert_file.description: Path to the SSL/TLS certificate file (required if auth_method = sslcert).

ssl_key_file.description: Path to the SSL/TLS private key file (required if auth_method = sslcert).

ssl_verify_client.description: Require and verify client SSL certificates (only applicable with sslcert auth).

trusted_ca_certs.description: Additional trusted CA certificates (paths) for validating client certs.

items.description: Absolute path to a trusted CA certificate file (PEM format).

max_metadata_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) allowed for a single metadata operation.

max_open_files.description: Maximum number of open file descriptors gfmd may use.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections.

client_idle_timeout.description: Client connection idle timeout in seconds (0 disables timeout).

enable_quota.description: Enable per-directory quota enforcement (requires quota DB support).

quota_db_path.description: Path to the SQLite database file for quota tracking.

journal_size_limit.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of a single journal file before rotation.

journal_rotation_count.description: Number of old journal files to retain after rotation.

journal_sync_writes.description: Force synchronous writes to journal (ensures durability, may reduce performance).

journal_dir.description: Directory where metadata journal files are stored.

compress_metadata.description: Compress metadata before writing to disk (saves space, minor CPU overhead).
